title: Gran Turismo 4
notes: Gran Turismo 4: the showroom models of the game (car/menu), read straight from GT4.VOL and dumped with Nenkai's GTPS2ModelTool.
Folder names are the game's model codes (maker + number: bmw_0009, niss0057, mazd0033 ...).  One car = ONE model with its interior, glass and lamps.
Body colour: the first colour of the game, baked into the textures (the game has up to 10 colours per car in the .pat files of the race models).

Left out on purpose: the additive reflection copy of the body, the alpha-only mask passes, the ground shadow, the head light ground cones and the dark liner shapes (wheel houses, floor plates, engine bay boxes: the black fill that the game draws behind the holes of the body).

Textures follow the game's own settings: holes of the body textures (wheel arches...) are transparent, textures that the game clamps are clamped (windows use UVs far outside 0..1), parts that lie in one plane (glass over the roof, lamps) are moved apart by fractions of a millimetre.

NO wheels: the game keeps wheel and tyre models in separate files and puts them on the axles with data from its car database.  Without the liners the wheel arches are open (see-through, transparent in the renders).  Two cars (jagu0005, mits0024) crash the tool in their showroom model: they are the race model (LOD0), first colour.  The 14 Mazda Roadster models have no hood in their model 0 (it is an alternative shape that the tool does not dump): the first alternative hood panel of the file is used.
RIMS: the folder _Rims holds the rims of wheel/menu (1159 files: the stock wheels of the cars, the race wheels and the shop wheels of BBS, Bridgestone, Enkei ...).

Model 0-3 of a file are the four corners: 59 wheels have another rear rim (<name>_rear), 11 another right rim (<name>_right).  Files with the same geometry and picture are one rim, _aliases.csv lists the other names.  A GT4 rim is modelled in a generic unit, its real size comes from the car database of the game: all rims here have the size of a 19 inch rim, standing on the ground, outer face towards +X.  The files hold the face of the rim and a short lip, no barrel and no tyre (the game's 89 tyres are files of their own, not bound to a rim).  The game adds a reflection pass whose strength is the alpha of the picture: here the picture is made brighter by its mean strength. 30 files crash the dump tool on their CLUT patch block (colour variants of the picture): that block is skipped, they have their first colour.
